definitions: To do things that are new or unfamiliar to you, or that make you feel nervous or uncomfortable.
To intentionally put oneself in situations that are outside of one's usual routine or abilities in order to grow or learn.
examples: She decided to step out of her comfort zone and try public speaking.
Traveling alone forced him to step out of his comfort zone.
To truly develop, you sometimes need to step out of your comfort zone.
lemma: step out of one's comfort zone
source: step out of one's comfort zone
